featured_partner_reviews.review_text: YMCA Hostel: A Haven for Students**||As a parent, I was filled with trepidation when my son secured admission to a hostel. However, all my worries dissipated upon our visit to the YMCA Hostel.||**Exceptional Amenities**||The hostel boasts a wide range of amenities that cater to the needs of students. Each room is well-furnished with comfortable beds, study desks, and ample storage space. The common areas are spacious and inviting, providing ample space for students to socialize and unwind.||**Impeccable Cleanliness and Maintenance**||The hostel is impeccably clean and well-maintained. The rooms are sanitized regularly, and the common areas are tidy and inviting. Students can rest assured that they are in a secure environment.||**Supportive and Professional Staff**||The hostel staff is incredibly supportive and professional. They are always willing to assist students with any needs or concerns they may have. They foster a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere that makes students feel at home away from home.||**Convenient Location**||The hostel is conveniently located near the educational institutions and other amenities. Students can easily access public transportation, shopping malls, and entertainment options.||**Value for Money**||The fees for YMCA Hostel are reasonable and provide excellent value for the amenities and services offered. Students get a comfortable and secure living space that supports their academic and personal growth.||**Conclusion**||As a parent, I am fully satisfied with the facilities and services provided by YMCA Hostel. My son has settled in well and is thriving in this exceptional environment. I highly recommend this hostel to parents and students seeking a safe, supportive, and nurturing living space for the duration of their studies.

⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at this location for one year. In that tenure I lost around many clothes given for a laundry. While leaving the hostel on 3rd September 2023 I came to know that my bags are missing. Upon asking for the same, the Abuzz staff acted like the are finding it and started looking for the same. I asked for CCTV footage also but they are unable to produce the same as the CCTV is not working. I also learned that this is not the first case of missing things. One girl lost her laptop, one gentleman lost his gold chain.
BEWARE if you are planning to go to this place. The place is not at all hygienic, they have only 3 toilets for the entire boy’s dorm, 1 active basin, Bathrooms with no soap holders and 24X7 running water from the broken pipeline.
I keep on asking for repair and got only one answer that they are looking for a plumber, in short they looked for a plumber for almost one year. Finally, when I decided to move out, I find that my bags are missing.
They do not have security neither they have cameras, so if you are shifting here, you are at your own. Your security is your concern. Do not carry any valuables.
Over all, this place is pathetic and strongly not recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: Staying at this hostel was a complete disaster. The place is full of rats, extremely dirty, and totally unhygienic. It feels unsafe to even sleep here. The staff and management don’t care about basic cleanliness or residents’ comfort. Laundry service is terrible — clothes are lost, delayed, or returned dirty. Water supply is unreliable and often unavailable for long hours. They charge money but provide horrible living conditions. I regret staying here and strongly advise others to stay away.

featured_reviews.name: Nikesh Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Reasonable value for the money given the location and its proximity to most places in the South. Your perception of the place would depend a lot on the kind of visitor you are. I'm writing this as an employee in a private organization.

Pros -
1. Location - it's in Parel, close to offices in Lower Parel, Elphinstone etc.
2. Pods were clean and the area was in general well maintained. Including the washroom
3. Well priced for a night.
4. Ample locked storage for visitors.

Cons -
1. Work area - there's no dedicated work area as such. You can work in the cafeteria but would have people coming in for meals and is in general small for the number of people staying there.

2. Canteen - I can't say anything about the food as I didn't have it there but around 8:15pm it was fully occupied because of the limited seating and so had to move to the terrace for dinner.

3. Reception - the check-in process wasn't too smooth. I was just expected to know what is where and while a lady did help me with the way to the bunker I'd have liked to be told about the facilities etc.

4. Connectivity - you don't get Airtel & Vodafone networks inside. Not atleast where my pod was. So I asked for WiFi and I was told that I can access WiFi only from reception, they wouldn't provide password of the other SSIDs that could have been accessed from the pod area. On the brighter side, that helped me go to sleep earlier than usual :)

5. Toiletries - most of the occupants here are students who are studying in colleges closeby and they have sort of been living at the hostel for a while. So even if you're there just for a day, you're expected to carry your towel, soap, shampoo, toothpaste etc. It's a hostel, not a hotel. :)

Please remember — a business runs because of its customers. If the staff is rude and arrogant, it creates a negative environment, and people won’t want to visit again.
Still, I acknowledge that the owner is a good and helpful person.
I hope you take this review seriously.
Thank you.
